messages.author: 43f18cf9ab7dee8f
messages.subject: Help
parts:
Dear all, 
I am analysing spatial data using the Bayesian framework. I have successfully created the adjacency matrix and all the necessary steps to develop the formula. 
Using the INLA package, I found the following messages when I try to execute the results. 
Any help, please?
This is the formula with codes I fitted: 
-Formulaw <- Sa2_G2$case16_mb ~ Sa2_G2$Percentile + f(Sa2_G2$SA2_5DIG16, Sa2_G2$re_U, model = "besag", graph = "g8", scale.model = TRUE) + f(Sa2_G2$re_V, model = "iid")
-res <- inla(formula = Formulaw, family = "poisson", data = as.data.frame(Sa2_G2), E=Sa2_G2$Expected, control.predictor, list(compute=TRUE))
*** inla.core.safe: inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=2/2 Error in if (n.from.graph <= 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts, : *** Fail to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.
Regards, 
Wubet
